aws_key_id.description: AWS access key ID. Provide with --from-env or stdin; never paste the value into chat or logs.

aws_region_name.description: AWS region for CloudTrail, for example us-east-1.

aws_secret_key.description: AWS secret access key. Provide with --from-env or stdin; never paste the value into chat or logs.

base_url.description: Optional CloudTrail endpoint override for fixture/local testing. Production defaults to https://cloudtrail.<region>.amazonaws.com.

page_size.description: Optional bounded MaxResults value for paginated read/query actions.

max_pages.description: Optional maximum page count for paginated read/query actions; use a positive integer.

mode.description: Set to fixture for credential-free native fixture tests.
